class RepairEngine:
    """修复引擎 - 负责各种内容的修复操作"""
    
    def repair_json_content(self, content: str, repair_depth: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
                "content": data,
                "changes": ["JSON语法验证通过"],
                "original_format": "valid_json"
            # JSON语法错误，尝试修复
            repaired_content = self.fix_json_syntax(content)
                data = json.loads(repaired_content)
                    "status": "repaired",
                    "changes": [f"修复JSON语法错误: {str(e)}"],
                    "original_format": "invalid_json"
                    "status": "repair_failed",
                    "changes": ["JSON修复失败"],
    
    def fix_json_syntax(self, content: str) -> str:
        content = re.sub(r'/\*.*?\*/', '', content, flags= re.DOTALL)
        
        # 修复未加引号的键
        content = re.sub(r'([{,]\s*)([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)(\s*:)', r'\1"\2"\3', content)
        
        # 修复缺少逗号
        content = re.sub(r'([}\]"])\s*([{["])', r'\1,\2', content)
        
        # 修复尾随逗号
        
    def repair_openapi_content(self, content: str, repair_depth: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """修复OpenAPI内容"""
        changes = []
        
        # 检测和修复Invalid params错误
        if 'Invalid params' in content or 'invalid' in content.lower():
            content = self.fix_invalid_params(content)
            changes.append("修复Invalid params错误")
        
        # 尝试解析为JSON或YAML
            if content.strip().startswith('{'):
                format_type = 'json'
                format_type = 'yaml'
                
                "changes": changes,
                "original_format": format_type
                "status": "parse_failed",
                "changes": changes + [f"解析失败: {str(e)}"],
                "original_format": "unknown"
    
    def fix_invalid_params(self, content: str) -> str:
        """修复Invalid params错误"""
        # 这里实现具体的Invalid params修复逻辑
        # 简化版本：移除明显的错误标记
        content = re.sub(r'Invalid params', 'parameters', content, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
        content = re.sub(r'invalid.*param', 'parameter', content, flags=re.IGNORECASE)

class CodeGenerator:
    """代码生成器 - 根据需求生成代码"""
    
    def generate_from_requirements(self, requirements: str, detail_level: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """根据自然语言需求生成代码"""
        
        # 分析需求类型
        requirement_type = self.analyze_requirement_type(requirements)
        
        if "coze" in requirements.lower() or "插件" in requirements:
            return self.generate_coze_plugin(requirements, detail_level)
        elif "api" in requirements.lower() or "接口" in requirements:
            return self.generate_api_spec(requirements, detail_level)
            return self.generate_general_code(requirements, detail_level)
    
    def analyze_requirement_type(self, requirements: str) -> str:
        """分析需求类型"""
        requirements_lower = requirements.lower()
        
        if any(word in requirements_lower for word in ['coze', '插件', '节点', '工作流']):
        elif any(word in requirements_lower for word in ['api', '接口', 'openapi', 'swagger']):
            return "api_spec"
        elif any(word in requirements_lower for word in ['网站', '网页', 'web', '前端']):
            return "web_app"
        elif any(word in requirements_lower for word in ['数据', '处理', '分析', '计算']):
            return "data_processing"
            return "general"
    
    def generate_coze_plugin(self, requirements: str, detail_level: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """生成Coze插件代码"""
        
        # 提取关键信息
        plugin_name = self.extract_plugin_name(requirements)
        functionality = self.extract_functionality(requirements)
        
        # 基础插件模板
        coze_plugin = {
            "node_id": f"coze_plugin_{plugin_name.lower().replace(' ', '_')}",
            "node_name": plugin_name,
            "node_description": f"基于需求生成的Coze插件: {functionality}",
            "input_variables": self.generate_input_variables(requirements),
                    "variable_id": "processing_result",
                    "variable_name": "处理结果",
                    "variable_type": "OBJECT",
                    "description": "插件执行结果"
            "generation_info": {
                "source_requirements": requirements,
                "detail_level": detail_level,
                "generation_timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat()
        
            "status": "generated",
            "content": coze_plugin,
            "changes": [f"根据需求生成Coze插件: {plugin_name}"],
            "requirements_analysis": {
                "plugin_name": plugin_name,
                "main_functionality": functionality,
                "input_requirements": self.extract_input_requirements(requirements)
    
    def extract_plugin_name(self, requirements: str) -> str:
        """从需求中提取插件名称"""
        # 简化实现，实际可以更智能
        if "天气" in requirements:
            return "天气查询插件"
        elif "翻译" in requirements:
            return "文本翻译插件" 
        elif "数据" in requirements:
            return "数据处理插件"
            return "自定义功能插件"
    
    def extract_functionality(self, requirements: str) -> str:
        """提取主要功能描述"""
        # 简化实现
        keywords = ['查询', '处理', '生成', '分析', '转换', '验证']
            if keyword in requirements:
                return f"提供{keyword}功能"
        return "提供定制化功能"
    
    def generate_input_variables(self, requirements: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """生成输入变量配置"""
        input_vars = []
        
        # 基于需求关键词生成输入变量
        if any(word in requirements for word in ['城市', '位置', '地点']):
            input_vars.append({
                "variable_id": "location",
                "variable_name": "位置信息", 
                "description": "输入城市名称或位置坐标"
        
        if any(word in requirements for word in ['文本', '内容', '文字']):
                "variable_id": "text_content", 
                "variable_name": "文本内容",
                "description": "输入需要处理的文本内容"
            
        if any(word in requirements for word in ['数量', '数字', '数值']):
                "variable_id": "numeric_value",
                "variable_name": "数值参数",
                "description": "输入数值参数"
        
        # 默认输入变量
        if not input_vars:
                "variable_id": "input_data",
                "variable_name": "输入数据",
                "description": "输入处理数据"
            
        return input_vars
    
    def extract_input_requirements(self, requirements: str) -> List[str]:
        """提取输入需求"""
        input_reqs = []
        
        if any(word in requirements for word in ['城市', '地址']):
            input_reqs.append("需要位置信息作为输入")
        if any(word in requirements for word in ['文本', '文字']):
            input_reqs.append("需要文本内容作为输入") 
        if any(word in requirements for word in ['文件', '数据']):
            input_reqs.append("需要数据文件作为输入")
            
        return input_reqs if input_reqs else ["需要通用数据输入"]
    
    def generate_api_spec(self, requirements: str, detail_level: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """生成API规范"""
        api_name = self.extract_api_name(requirements)
        
        openapi_spec = {
                "title": api_name,
                "description": f"基于需求生成的API: {requirements}",
                "/api/endpoint": {
                        "summary": "主要API端点",
                                "description": "成功响应",
                                                "data": {"type": "object"}
        
            "content": openapi_spec,
            "changes": [f"根据需求生成API规范: {api_name}"]
    
    def extract_api_name(self, requirements: str) -> str:
        """提取API名称"""
        if "用户" in requirements:
            return "用户管理API"
        elif "订单" in requirements:
            return "订单处理API"
        elif "产品" in requirements:
            return "产品信息API"
            return "通用服务API"
    
    def generate_general_code(self, requirements: str, detail_level: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """生成通用代码"""
                "code_type": "python",
                "implementation": f"# 基于需求生成的代码\n# 需求: {requirements}\n\ndef main():\n    print('功能实现代码')\n    return {'status': 'success'}",
                "requirements": requirements,
                "generation_level": detail_level
            "changes": ["根据自然语言需求生成代码框架"]

class ContentValidator:

完整的配置文件
创建 config.yaml 配置文件：

# Coze全功能自动化修复工具配置
tool_config:
  name: "Coze全功能自动化修复工具"
  description: "统一自动化代码修复和转换中心"
  author: "自动化修复引擎"

processing_modes:
  auto_detect:
    name: "自动检测模式"
    description: "自动识别输入内容类型并选择最佳处理方式"
  coze_plugin_repair:
    name: "Coze插件修复" 
    description: "专门修复Coze插件JSON结构错误和兼容性问题"
  openapi_merge_fix:
    name: "OpenAPI合并修复"
    description: "合并多个OpenAPI规范并修复Invalid params错误"
  code_generation:
    name: "代码生成"
    description: "根据自然语言需求生成完整可运行的代码"
  error_diagnosis:
    name: "错误诊断"
    description: "深度分析代码错误并提供修复建议"
  structure_optimization:
    name: "结构优化"
    description: "优化代码结构和性能"

repair_depths:
  basic:
    name: "基本修复"
    description: "修复明显的语法错误和结构问题"
    features:
      - "JSON/YAML语法修复"
      - "基本结构验证"
      - "必需字段补充"
  comprehensive:
    name: "全面修复"
    description: "全面修复语法、结构和逻辑问题"
      - "包含基本修复所有功能"
      - "Coze平台兼容性修复"
      - "输入输出变量标准化"
      - "错误参数修正"
  thorough:
    name: "彻底修复"
    description: "深度修复包括性能优化和安全性增强"
      - "包含全面修复所有功能"
      - "性能优化建议"
      - "安全性检查"
      - "代码结构重构"

output_formats:
  standard_json:
    name: "标准JSON格式"
    description: "格式化的JSON，便于阅读和编辑"
  formatted_yaml:
    name: "格式化YAML"
    description: "结构清晰的YAML格式输出"
  coze_import_ready:
    name: "Coze直接导入格式"
    description: "符合Coze平台导入要求的完整格式"
  minified:
    name: "压缩格式"
    description: "去除空格的压缩格式，文件体积最小"

# 自动化设置
automation_settings:
  enable_auto_detection: true
  enable_smart_repair: true
  enable_compatibility_check: true
  enable_performance_optimization: false
  backup_original_files: true

# 验证规则
validation_rules:
  coze_plugin:
    required_fields:
      - "node_id"
      - "node_name" 
      - "input_variables"
      - "output_variables"
    field_types:
      node_id: "string"
      node_name: "string"
      input_variables: "array"
      output_variables: "array"
  openapi_spec:
      - "openapi"
      - "info"
      - "paths"
    version_requirements:
      min_version: "3.0.0"

# 错误处理配置
error_handling:
  max_retry_attempts: 3
  fallback_strategies:
    - "basic_repair"
    - "structure_preservation"
    - "partial_recovery"
  log_level: "INFO"

# 性能配置
performance:
  max_file_size_mb: 10
  timeout_seconds: 30
  memory_limit_mb: 512
使用说明文档
创建 README.md 使用说明：

markdown
# Coze全功能自动化修复工具

## 功能概述

这是一个统一的自动化代码修复和转换中心，支持以下核心功能：

### 🛠️ 主要功能
1. **Coze插件修复** - 自动修复Coze插件JSON结构错误
2. **OpenAPI合并修复** - 合并多个OpenAPI规范并修复Invalid params错误  
3. **代码生成** - 根据自然语言需求生成完整可运行的代码
4. **错误诊断** - 深度分析代码错误并提供修复建议
5. **结构优化** - 优化代码结构和性能

### 🎯 特色功能
- 🔍 **智能内容识别** - 自动检测输入内容类型
- 🤖 **全自动处理** - 一键修复所有检测到的问题
- 📊 **多级修复深度** - 基本/全面/彻底三级修复
- 💾 **多种输出格式** - JSON/YAML/Coze导入格式
- ✅ **兼容性验证** - 自动检查Coze平台兼容性

## 快速开始

### 安装依赖
pip install pyyaml
基本使用

    repair_depth='comprehensive',   # 全面修复
    enable_automation=True,         # 启用自动化
    output_format='standard_json'   # 标准JSON输出

print(result['formatted_output'])

# 交互式使用

标准JSON格式
  "node_id": "repaired_plugin",
  "node_name": "修复后的插件",
  "input_variables": [...],
  "output_variables": [...]
Coze导入格式

  "export_timestamp": "...",
  "tool_info": {...}
错误处理
工具提供详细的错误信息和修复建议：

🔴 严重错误 - 阻止继续处理的错误

🟡 警告信息 - 不影响使用但建议修复的问题

🟢 优化建议 - 性能和改进建议

Coze全功能自动化修复工具测试用例

import unittest
from coze_repair_tool import CozeAutomatedRepairTool, RepairEngine, CodeGenerator

class TestCozeRepairTool(unittest.TestCase):
    
    def setUp(self):
        self.tool = CozeAutomatedRepairTool()
    
    def test_json_repair(self):
        """测试JSON修复功能"""
        broken_json = '''
            node_id: "test_plugin",
            "node_name": "测试插件",
                    "variable_id": "input1"
                    "variable_name": "输入1",
                    "variable_type": "STRING"
        
        result = self.repair_engine.repair_json_content(broken_json, "comprehensive")
        self.assertEqual(result["status"], "repaired")
        self.assertIn("content", result)
    
    def test_content_detection(self):
        """测试内容类型检测"""
        # Coze插件检测
        coze_content = '{"node_id": "test", "input_variables": []}'
        detected_type = self.tool.detect_content_type(coze_content)
        self.assertEqual(detected_type, "coze_plugin")
        
        json_content = '{"name": "test", "value": 123}'
        detected_type = self.tool.detect_content_type(json_content)
        self.assertEqual(detected_type, "json")
        
        natural_content = "请创建一个天气查询插件"
        detected_type = self.tool.detect_content_type(natural_content)
        self.assertEqual(detected_type, "natural_language")
    
    def test_coze_plugin_generation(self):

    def extract_json_fragments(self, content: str) -> List[str]:
        """提取JSON片段"""
        fragments = []
        stack = []
        start = -1
        
        for i, char in enumerate(content):
            if char in ['{', '[']:

                stack.append(char)
            elif char in ['}', ']']:

                    if not stack and start != -1:
                        fragment = content[start:i+1]
                        fragments.append(fragment)

    def deep_merge(self, target: Dict, source: Dict, changes: List[str], source_name: str) -> Dict:
                    target[key] = self.deep_merge(target[key], value, changes, source_name)

    def deduplicate_merged_data(self, data: Dict[str, Any], changes: List[str]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """去重合并后的数据"""
        if 'paths' in data and isinstance(data['paths'], dict):
            # 去重路径
            unique_paths = {}
            for path, methods in data['paths'].items():
                if path not in unique_paths:
                    unique_paths[path] = methods
                    # 合并方法
                    for method, spec in methods.items():
                        if method not in unique_paths[path]:
                            unique_paths[path][method] = spec
                            # 保留更完整的规范
                            if isinstance(spec, dict) and isinstance(unique_paths[path][method], dict):
                                if len(str(spec)) > len(str(unique_paths[path][method])):
            
            if len(unique_paths) < len(data['paths']):
                changes.append(f"去重路径: {len(data['paths']) - len(unique_paths)}个重复项")
                data['paths'] = unique_paths
        
        if 'components' in data and isinstance(data['components'], dict):
            # 去重组件
            for component_type, components in data['components'].items():
                if isinstance(components, dict):
                    # 移除重复组件
                    unique_components = {}
                    for name, component in components.items():
                        component_hash = self.calculate_hash(json.dumps(component, sort_keys=True))
                        if component_hash not in seen:
                            seen.add(component_hash)
                            unique_components[name] = component
                    
                    if len(unique_components) < len(components):
                        changes.append(f"去重{component_type}: {len(components) - len(unique_components)}个重复项")
                        data['components'][component_type] = unique_components
        
    def calculate_hash(self, content: str) -> str:
        return hashlib.md5(content.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()

    def sanitize_id(self, text: str) -> str:
        """清理文本为有效的ID"""
        # 移除特殊字符，保留字母、数字、下划线、中文
        sanitized = re.sub(r'[^\w\u4e00-\u9fa5]', '_', text)
        # 移除连续下划线
        sanitized = re.sub(r'_+', '_', sanitized)
        # 移除首尾下划线
        sanitized = sanitized.strip('_')
        # 如果为空，使用默认值
        if not sanitized:
            sanitized = 'coze_plugin'
        
        return sanitized.lower()
    
    def sanitize_class_name(self, text: str) -> str:
        """清理文本为有效的类名"""

        sanitized = re.sub(r'[^a-zA-Z0-9]', '', text)
            sanitized = 'App'
        
        # 确保首字母大写
        return sanitized[0].upper() + sanitized[1:]

    def get_file_info(file_path: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:

    def find_files(directory: str, extensions: List[str]) -> List[str]:
        """查找指定扩展名的文件"""
        found_files = []
        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(directory):
                if any(file.lower().endswith(ext.lower()) for ext in extensions):
                    found_files.append(os.path.join(root, file))
        return found_files
    
    def compare_files(file1: str, file2: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """比较两个文件"""
            content1 = FileUtils.read_file(file1)
            content2 = FileUtils.read_file(file2)
            
                "are_identical": content1 == content2,
                "size1": len(content1),
                "size2": len(content2),
                "lines1": content1.count('\n') + 1,
                "lines2": content2.count('\n') + 1,
                "similarity": FileUtils.calculate_similarity(content1, content2)
                "are_identical": False
    
    def calculate_similarity(content1: str, content2: str) -> float:
        """计算内容相似度"""
        if not content1 or not content2:
            return 0.0
        
        # 简单的相似度计算（基于相同行数）
        lines1 = set(content1.split('\n'))
        lines2 = set(content2.split('\n'))
        
        intersection = lines1.intersection(lines2)
        union = lines1.union(lines2)
        
        if not union:
        
        return len(intersection) / len(union)
    
    def merge_similar_files(files: List[str], output_file: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """合并相似文件"""
        if not files:
            return {"status": "error", "message": "没有文件可合并"}
        
            # 读取所有文件内容
            contents = []
                content = FileUtils.read_file(file)
                contents.append({
                    "file": file,
                    "size": len(content),
                    "lines": content.count('\n') + 1
            
            # 分析文件类型
            extensions = {}
            for content_info in contents:
                ext = os.path.splitext(content_info["file"])[1].lower()
                if ext not in extensions:
                    extensions[ext] = []
                extensions[ext].append(content_info)
            
            # 按扩展名分组处理
            merged_content = {}
            for ext, files_info in extensions.items():
                if len(files_info) == 1:
                    # 只有一个文件，直接使用
                    merged_content[ext] = files_info[0]["content"]
                    # 多个文件，尝试合并
                    # 对于JSON/YAML文件，尝试合并内容
                    if ext in ['.json', '.yaml', '.yml']:
                        merged = FileUtils.merge_structured_files(files_info, ext)
                        merged_content[ext] = merged
                        # 对于其他文件，拼接内容
                        combined = "\n\n".join([info["content"] for info in files_info])
                        merged_content[ext] = combined
            
            # 写入输出文件
            if len(merged_content) == 1:
                # 只有一种类型，直接写入
                for content in merged_content.values():
                    FileUtils.write_file(output_file, content)
                # 多种类型，创建目录
                os.makedirs(output_file, exist_ok=True)
                for ext, content in merged_content.items():
                    base_name = os.path.basename(output_file)
                    name_without_ext = os.path.splitext(base_name)[0]
                    ext_file = os.path.join(output_file, f"{name_without_ext}{ext}")
                    FileUtils.write_file(ext_file, content)
            
                "merged_files": len(files),
                "file_types": len(extensions),
                "output": output_file,
                    "extensions": list(extensions.keys()),
                    "total_size": sum(info["size"] for info in contents),
                    "total_lines": sum(info["lines"] for info in contents)
            
                "message": str(e),
                "merged_files": 0
    
    def merge_structured_files(files_info: List[Dict[str, Any]], file_type: str) -> str:
        """合并结构化文件（JSON/YAML）"""
        if file_type == '.json':
            return FileUtils.merge_json_files(files_info)
        else:  # YAML
            return FileUtils.merge_yaml_files(files_info)
    
    def merge_json_files(files_info: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> str:
        """合并JSON文件"""
        
        for info in files_info:
                data = json.loads(info["content"])
                # 深度合并
                merged_data = FileUtils.deep_merge_json(merged_data, data)
                # 如果解析失败，作为字符串处理
        
        return json.dumps(merged_data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

    def merge_files(self, content: str, repair_depth: str, enable_automation: bool) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """合并文件"""
        print("🔗 合并文件内容...")
        
        # 解析输入内容（可能是文件路径或文件内容）
        if os.path.exists(content):
            # 是文件路径
            files = [content]
            is_file_path = True
            # 可能是多文件内容，尝试分割
            files_content = self.split_multiple_files(content)
            files = files_content
            is_file_path = False
        
            if is_file_path:
                # 读取文件内容
                        content_str = self.file_utils.read_file(file_path)
                        contents.append(content_str)
                        print(f"⚠️ 读取文件失败 {file_path}: {str(e)}")
                
                if len(contents) == 1:
                    # 单个文件，直接处理
                    return self.auto_detect_and_process(contents[0], repair_depth, enable_automation)
                    # 多个文件，合并
                    # 首先尝试识别文件类型
                    file_types = []
                    for content_str in contents:
                        file_type = self.detect_content_type(content_str)
                        file_types.append(file_type)
                    
                    # 如果所有文件类型相同，合并
                    if len(set(file_types)) == 1:
                        merge_type = file_types[0]
                        if merge_type in ['json', 'coze_plugin']:
                            # 合并JSON文件
                            merge_result = self.repair_engine.merge_multiple_files(contents, "json")
                                "operation": "file_merge",
                                "status": merge_result["status"],
                                "merged_content": merge_result.get("content", {}),
                                "changes_applied": merge_result.get("changes", []),
                                    "merged_count": merge_result.get("merged_count", 0),
                                    "file_type": merge_type
                        elif merge_type == 'openapi':
                            # 合并OpenAPI文件
                            merge_result = self.repair_engine.merge_multiple_files(contents, "yaml")
                    
                    # 不同类型文件，无法合并
                        "error": "文件类型不一致，无法合并",
                        "file_types": file_types,
                        "file_count": len(files)
                # 已经是文件内容
                    return self.auto_detect_and_process(files[0], repair_depth, enable_automation)
                    # 多个文件内容，尝试合并
                    # 这里简化处理，只处理第一个文件
                "operation": "file_analysis",
                "file_count": len(files) if isinstance(files, list) else 1,
                "is_file_path": is_file_path,
                    "确认文件类型一致性",
                    "检查文件编码",
                    "验证文件完整性",
                    "备份原始文件"
    
    def split_multiple_files(self, content: str) -> List[str]:
        """分割多个文件内容"""
        # 简单实现：按常见分隔符分割
        separators = ['\n---\n', '\n###\n', '\n\n\n']
        
        for separator in separators:
            if separator in content:
                return content.split(separator)
        
        # 如果没有明确分隔符，尝试按格式检测
        parts = []
        current_part = []
        
            # 检测可能的文件开始
            if line.strip() and (line.startswith('{') or line.startswith('---') or 'openapi' in line.lower()):
                if current_part:
                    parts.append('\n'.join(current_part))
            current_part.append(line)
        
        return parts if len(parts) > 1 else [content]
    
    def batch_process(self, input_data: str, repair_depth: str, enable_automation: bool, 
                     batch_config: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """批量处理"""
        print("📦 批量处理任务...")
        
        # 解析输入数据（可能是文件路径列表或目录）
        if isinstance(input_data, str) and os.path.exists(input_data):
            if os.path.isdir(input_data):
                # 是目录，查找所有文件
                extensions = batch_config.get('extensions', ['.json', '.yaml', '.yml', '.txt'])
                files = self.file_utils.find_files(input_data, extensions)
                input_type = "directory"
                # 是文件，可能是包含文件列表的文件
                    with open(input_data, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                        file_list = f.read().strip().split('\n')
                    files = [f.strip() for f in file_list if f.strip() and os.path.exists(f.strip())]
                    input_type = "file_list"
                    files = [input_data]
                    input_type = "single_file"
            # 可能是直接的文件内容列表
            files = input_data.split('\n') if '\n' in input_data else [input_data]
            input_type = "content_list"
        
        print(f"📁 发现 {len(files)} 个文件/内容需要处理")
        
        success_count = 0
        fail_count = 0
        
        for i, file_item in enumerate(files):
            print(f"  [{i+1}/{len(files)}] 处理项目 {i+1}...")
            
                if input_type in ["directory", "file_list", "single_file"]:
                    # 文件路径
                    if os.path.exists(file_item):
                        content = self.file_utils.read_file(file_item)
                        file_info = self.file_utils.get_file_info(file_item)
                        print(f"    ⚠️ 文件不存在: {file_item}")
                        fail_count += 1
                    # 直接内容
                    content = file_item
                    file_info = {"path": f"content_{i+1}", "size": len(content)}
                
                # 处理内容
                mode = batch_config.get('processing_mode', 'auto_detect')
                result = self.process_user_input(
                    content, mode, repair_depth, enable_automation,
                    batch_config.get('output_format', 'standard_json')
                
                if batch_config.get('save_results', False):
                    output_dir = batch_config.get('output_dir', 'batch_results')
                    
                        base_name = os.path.basename(file_item)
                        output_file = os.path.join(output_dir, f"{name_without_ext}_processed.json")
                        output_file = os.path.join(output_dir, f"content_{i+1}_processed.json")
                    
                results.append({
                    "item": file_item,
                    "file_info": file_info,
                    "result": result,
                    "status": result.get("status", "unknown")
                
                if result.get("status") == "success":
                    success_count += 1
                    
                print(f"    ❌ 处理失败: {str(e)}")
                    "status": "error"
        
            "operation": "batch_processing",
            "results_summary": {
                "total": len(files),
                "success": success_count,
                "failed": fail_count,
                "success_rate": success_count / max(len(files), 1)
            "input_type": input_type,
            "batch_config": batch_config,
            "detailed_results": results,
            "processing_time": sum(r.get("result", {}).get("processing_time_seconds", 0) for r in results if "result" in r)
    
    def generic_repair(self, content: str, repair_depth: str, enable_automation: bool) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """通用修复"""
        print("🔧 执行通用修复...")
        
        # 尝试各种修复策略
        strategies = [
            self.try_json_repair,
            self.try_yaml_repair,
            self.try_text_cleanup
        
        for strategy in strategies:
                result = strategy(content, repair_depth)
                if result["status"] in ["success", "repaired"]:
                        "operation": "generic_repair",
                        "status": result["status"],
                        "strategy_used": strategy.__name__,
                        "repaired_content": result.get("content", content),
                        "changes_applied": result.get("changes", ["通用修复成功"]),
                        "content_type": result.get("content_type", "unknown")
        
        # 所有策略都失败
            "error": "所有修复策略都失败",
            "original_content": content[:500] + ("..." if len(content) > 500 else ""),
                "尝试手动修复",
                "提供更详细的信息"
    
    def try_json_repair(self, content: str, repair_depth: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """尝试JSON修复"""
        return self.repair_engine.repair_json_content(content, repair_depth)
    
    def try_yaml_repair(self, content: str, repair_depth: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """尝试YAML修复"""
            raise ValueError("不是有效的YAML")
    
    def try_text_cleanup(self, content: str, repair_depth: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """尝试文本清理"""
        cleaned = content.strip()
        
        # 移除多余的空行
        lines = cleaned.split('\n')
            if line or (cleaned_lines and cleaned_lines[-1]):  # 保留有意义的空行
        
        cleaned = '\n'.join(cleaned_lines)
        
            "content": cleaned,
            "changes_applied": ["清理空白字符", "规范化行结束符"],
            "content_type": "text"
    
    def format_output(self, result: Dict[str, Any], output_format: str) -> str:
        """格式化输出"""
            return json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
            return yaml.dump(result, allow_unicode=True, default_flow_style=False)
            return json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':'))
            # 针对Coze导入优化格式
            if "repaired_content" in result:
                coze_data = {
                    "nodes": [result["repaired_content"]] if isinstance(result["repaired_content"], dict) else result["repaired_content"],
                    "exported_by": self.tool_name,
                    "export_time": datetime.now().isoformat()
                return json.dumps(coze_data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
        elif output_format == "pretty_all":
            # 尝试美化所有内容
                    return str(result)
    
    def generate_processing_report(self, original_content: str, result: Dict[str, Any], 
                                 start_time: datetime, processing_time: float,
                                 processing_mode: str, repair_depth: str, 
                                 output_format: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        report = {
                "tool": self.tool_name,
                "original_size_bytes": len(original_content),
                "result_status": result.get("status", "unknown")
            "operations": [],
                "changes_applied": len(result.get("changes_applied", [])),
                "validation_errors": 0,
                "validation_warnings": 0
            "performance": {
                "processing_speed_bytes_per_second": len(original_content) / max(processing_time, 0.001),
                "efficiency_rating": "high" if processing_time < 5 else "medium" if processing_time < 30 else "low"
        
        # 添加操作详情
        if "operation" in result:
            report["operations"].append({
                "type": result["operation"],
                "details": result.get("details", {})
        
        # 添加验证信息
        if "validation_result" in result:
            validation = result["validation_result"]
            report["statistics"]["validation_errors"] = len(validation.get("errors", []))
            report["statistics"]["validation_warnings"] = len(validation.get("warnings", []))
        
        # 添加内容哈希
        if "content_hash" in result:
            report["content_integrity"] = {
                "original_hash": result["content_hash"].get("original", ""),
                "repaired_hash": result["content_hash"].get("repaired", ""),
                "has_changed": result["content_hash"].get("original") != result["content_hash"].get("repaired")
        
    def check_compatibility(self, result: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """检查兼容性"""
            "coze_platform": {
                "compatible": False,
                "score": 0
                "valid": False,
                "version": "",
                "issues": []
            "general": {
                "well_formed": True,
        
        # 检查Coze平台兼容性
            content = result["repaired_content"]
                # Coze插件检查
                if all(key in content for key in ['node_id', 'node_name', 'input_variables']):
                    compatibility["coze_platform"]["compatible"] = True
                    compatibility["coze_platform"]["score"] = 80
                    
                    # 详细检查
                    if not content.get('output_variables'):
                        compatibility["coze_platform"]["issues"].append("缺少output_variables")
                        compatibility["coze_platform"]["score"] -= 20
                    
                    if not isinstance(content.get('input_variables'), list):
                        compatibility["coze_platform"]["issues"].append("input_variables不是数组")
                
                # OpenAPI检查
                    compatibility["openapi_spec"]["valid"] = True
                    compatibility["openapi_spec"]["version"] = content.get('openapi', 'unknown')
                    
                    if not content.get('paths'):
                        compatibility["openapi_spec"]["issues"].append("缺少paths字段")
                    
                    if not content.get('info'):
                        compatibility["openapi_spec"]["issues"].append("缺少info字段")
        
        # 通用建议
        if result.get("status") == "failed":
            compatibility["general"]["suggestions"].append("修复失败，建议检查输入内容")
        
            if validation.get("errors"):
                compatibility["general"]["well_formed"] = False
                compatibility["general"]["suggestions"].append("存在验证错误，建议修复")
        
    def generate_recommendations(self, result: Dict[str, Any]) -> List[str]:
        
        # 基于结果状态的建议
        status = result.get("status", "")
        if status == "failed":
                "检查输入内容的格式和语法",
                "降低修复深度级别"
        elif status == "success":
                "验证修复结果是否符合预期",
                "测试生成代码的功能完整性",
                "考虑进行性能优化"
        
        # 基于操作类型的建议
        operation = result.get("operation", "")
        if "coze_plugin" in operation:
                "在Coze平台测试插件功能",
                "优化输入输出变量描述",
                "添加错误处理机制"
        elif "openapi" in operation:
                "使用Swagger UI验证API文档",
                "添加更多API示例",
                "完善安全Schemes定义"
        elif "code_generation" in operation:
                "测试生成代码的运行效果",
                "添加单元测试",
                "优化代码结构和性能"
        
        # 基于验证结果的建议
                recommendations.append("修复验证报告中的错误")
            if validation.get("warnings"):
                recommendations.append("处理验证报告中的警告")
            if validation.get("suggestions"):
                recommendations.extend(validation["suggestions"][:3])  # 只取前3条
        
        # 去除重复建议
        unique_recommendations = []
        for rec in recommendations:
            if rec not in seen:
                seen.add(rec)
                unique_recommendations.append(rec)
        
        return unique_recommendations[:10]  # 最多返回10条建议

2. 完整配置文件 (config.yaml)
# Coze全功能自动化修复工具配置 v2.0.0

# 工具信息
tool_info:
  version: "2.0.0"
  author: "全自动化修复引擎"
  website: "https://github.com/coze-tools/automated-repair"

automation:
  enable_backup: true
  backup_location: "./backups"
  
  # 智能修复设置
  smart_repair:
      - "segmented_repair"
      - "aggressive_repair"
    preserve_comments: true
    normalize_format: true

    priority: 1
    description: "自动检测内容类型并选择最佳处理方式"
    
    priority: 2
      validate_structure: true
      fix_missing_fields: true
      normalize_ids: true
      add_default_outputs: true
      
    priority: 3
      merge_strategy: "deep_merge"
      deduplicate: true
      validate_openapi: true
      fix_invalid_refs: true
      
    priority: 4
      template_library: "default"
      detail_level: "comprehensive"
      include_comments: true
      add_error_handling: true
      
    priority: 5
      check_syntax: true
      check_structure: true
      check_logic: true
      check_performance: true
      
    priority: 6
      remove_duplicates: true
      optimize_formatting: true
      sort_keys: true
      minify_output: false
      
  file_merge:
    priority: 7
    description: "合并相同类型的多个文件"
      merge_similar_files: true
      preserve_originals: true
      create_index: true
      
  batch_processing:
    priority: 8
    description: "批量处理多个文件或内容"
      concurrent_processing: false
      max_concurrent: 4
      progress_reporting: true

    level: 1
      - "常见错误修正"
      
    level: 2
      - "格式规范化"
      
    level: 3
      - "高级错误恢复"

      indent: 2
      sort_keys: false
      ensure_ascii: false
      
      default_flow_style: false
      allow_unicode: true
      
      wrap_in_nodes: true
      add_metadata: true
      export_timestamp: true
      
      separators: [",", ":"]
      compact: true
      
  pretty_all:
    description: "自动美化所有支持的格式"
      auto_detect_format: true
      fallback_to_json: true

# 文件处理设置
file_handling:
  supported_extensions:
    - ".json"
    - ".yaml"
    - ".yml"
    - ".txt"
    - ".md"
    - ".js"
    - ".ts"
    - ".py"
    
  encoding:
    default: "utf-8"
    fallback: "gbk"
    
  backup:
    prefix: "backup_"
    max_backups: 5

validation:
      
      node_description: "string"
      
    input_variable_requirements:
        - "variable_id"
        - "variable_name"
        - "variable_type"
      valid_types:
        - "STRING"
        - "NUMBER"
        - "BOOLEAN"
        - "OBJECT"
        - "ARRAY"
        
    info_requirements:
        - "title"
        - "version"
        
      recommended: "3.0.3"

  retry_delay_ms: 1000
  
    - name: "basic_repair"
      description: "回退到基本修复策略"
      
    - name: "segmented_repair"
      description: "尝试分段修复"
      
    - name: "preserve_and_report"
      description: "保留原始内容并报告错误"
      
  logging:
    level: "INFO"
    file: "coze_repair.log"
    max_size_mb: 10
    backup_count: 5

  cache_size_mb: 100
  
  optimization:
    enable_multiprocessing: false
    max_workers: 4
    chunk_size: 10

# 安全设置
  sanitize_input: true
  max_nesting_level: 100
  max_string_length: 10000
  
  file_safety:
    check_file_size: true
    validate_file_type: true
    scan_for_malicious: false

# 用户界面设置
ui:
  progress_indicator: true
  color_output: true
  unicode_symbols: true
  
  verbosity_levels:
    quiet: 0
    normal: 1
    verbose: 2
    debug: 3
    
  output_colors:
    success: "green"
    error: "red"
    warning: "yellow"
    info: "blue"

# 集成配置
integrations:
  coze_platform:
    api_version: "v1"
    validate_before_export: true
    
  openapi_tools:
    swagger_ui: false
    redoc: false
    
  code_quality:
    enable_linting: false
    linting_tools:
      - "pylint"
      - "eslint"

# 扩展功能
extensions:
  code_templates:
    location: "./templates"
    default_templates:
      - "coze_plugin"
      - "python_app"
      
  custom_rules:
    location: "./rules"
    enabled: false
    
  plugins:
    location: "./plugins"

# 默认值
defaults:
  processing_mode: "auto_detect"
  repair_depth: "comprehensive"
  output_format: "standard_json"
  enable_automation: true
  
    output_dir: "./batch_results"
    save_intermediate: false
    create_report: true

# 版本控制
versioning:
  config_version: "2.0.0"
  last_updated: "2024-01-01"
  compatible_tool_versions:
    min: "2.0.0"
    max: "3.0.0"

5. 完整使用说明 (README.md)

**Coze全功能自动化修复工具**是一个统一的自动化代码修复和转换中心，专门用于处理Coze插件、OpenAPI规范、JSON/YAML文件和自然语言需求。它实现了真正的全自动化操作体验，基于"无变动保留原文内容"原则，只修复技术错误而不改变原始意图。

- 🔄 **全自动化修复** - 智能检测和修复各种代码错误
- 🎯 **多格式支持** - JSON、YAML、OpenAPI、Coze插件、自然语言
- 🛠️ **多功能集成** - 修复、生成、合并、优化、验证一体化
- 📊 **智能分析** - 自动内容类型检测和最佳处理策略选择
- 🔧 **可配置深度** - 基本、全面、彻底三级修复深度
- 💾 **多种输出** - 标准JSON、格式化YAML、Coze导入格式等
- 🚀 **批量处理** - 支持目录和文件列表的批量操作
- 📈 **详细报告** - 完整的处理报告和优化建议

### 安装

# 克隆仓库
git clone https://github.com/coze-tools/automated-repair.git
cd automated-repair

# 安装依赖
pip install -r requirements.txt

# 或者使用最小安装
pip install pyyaml colorama
# 直接输入内容
python main.py --input '{"node_id": "test", "node_name": "测试插件"}'

python main.py --file plugin.json --mode coze_plugin_repair

# 批量处理目录
python main.py --dir ./plugins --mode batch_processing --output ./results

python main.py --input "创建一个天气查询Coze插件" --mode code_generation
Python API
from main import CozeAutomatedRepairTool

    user_input_content='你的内容',
    processing_mode='auto_detect',
    repair_depth='comprehensive',
    output_format='standard_json'

OpenAPI规范 → OpenAPI合并修复

自然语言 → 代码生成

JSON/YAML → 通用修复

多文件内容 → 文件合并

🔧 Coze插件修复 (coze_plugin_repair)

标准化输入输出变量

验证Coze平台兼容性

优化插件结构

    features: [...]

export COZE_REPAIR_CONFIG=./config.yaml

插件系统
# plugins/custom_processor.py
from typing import Dict, Any
from main import BaseProcessor

class CustomProcessor(BaseProcessor):
    """自定义处理器插件"""
    
    def process(self, content: str, config: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        # 自定义处理逻辑
        result = {
            "status": "processed",
            "content": self.custom_logic(content),
            "metadata": {"processor": "custom"}
    
    def custom_logic(self, content: str) -> str:
        # 实现自定义逻辑
        return content.upper()

    result = tool.process_user_input(**data)
    return jsonify(result)

📚 常见问题
Q1: 工具支持哪些文件格式？
A: 支持JSON、YAML、OpenAPI、Coze插件格式、自然语言文本，以及常见代码文件。

Q2: 如何处理大文件？
A: 工具会自动检测文件大小，对超过配置限制的文件进行分段处理。可以通过调整max_file_size_mb配置来增加限制。

Q3: 修复会改变原始内容吗？
A: 工具遵循"无变动保留原文内容"原则，只修复技术错误，不改变原始意图和核心内容。

Q4: 支持并发处理吗？
A: 是的，批量处理模式支持并发处理，可以通过配置启用。

Q5: 如何扩展功能？
A: 可以通过插件系统、自定义模板和规则文件来扩展功能。

Q6: 有Web界面吗？
A: 当前主要是命令行工具，但可以通过API服务构建Web界面。

def run_all_tests():
    """运行所有测试"""
    # 创建测试套件
    loader = unittest.TestLoader()
    
    # 添加测试类
    test_classes = [
        TestRepairEngine,
        TestCodeGenerator,
        TestContentValidator,
        TestFileUtils,
        TestMainTool,
        TestIntegration,
        TestPerformance
    
    suites = []
    for test_class in test_classes:
        suite = loader.loadTestsFromTestCase(test_class)
        suites.append(suite)
    
    # 合并所有测试套件
    all_tests = unittest.TestSuite(suites)
    
    runner = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2)
    result = runner.run(all_tests)
    
    # 输出测试统计
    print("📊 测试结果统计")
    print(f"运行测试: {result.testsRun}")
    print(f"成功: {result.testsRun - len(result.failures) - len(result.errors)}")
    print(f"失败: {len(result.failures)}")
    print(f"错误: {len(result.errors)}")
    
    if result.failures:
        print("\n❌ 失败的测试:")
        for test, traceback in result.failures:
            print(f"  - {test}")
    
    if result.errors:
        print("\n💥 错误的测试:")
        for test, traceback in result.errors:
    
    return result.wasSuccessful()

    print("🤖 开始运行Coze全功能自动化修复工具测试套件...")
    
    success = run_all_tests()
    
    if success:
        print("\n🎉 所有测试通过!")
        print("\n❌ 测试失败!")

    processing_time: float = 0.0
    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    exists: bool = False
    content: str = ""

Coze 全自动插件开发与修复系统 - 完整解决方案
一、系统架构与核心功能
1.1 系统概述
Coze 全自动插件开发与修复系统是一个基于大语言模型的智能开发平台，实现从自然语言需求到完整插件代码的一站式自动化开发。系统集成智能诊断、自动修复、代码生成和测试验证全流程，专为零基础用户设计。

1.2 核心功能模块
用户输入

智能解析器

输入类型判断

自然语言需求

2.1 环境准备与初始化
2.1.1 应用创建
# 创建Coze应用
coze-cli app create --name "PluginAutoGenerator" --desc "全自动插件开发系统"

# 创建工作流
coze-cli workflow create --name "plugin_auto_workflow" --desc "插件自动化工作流"
2.1.2 依赖配置
# package.yaml
dependencies:
  - name: "coze-sdk"
    version: "^2.0.0"
  - name: "typescript"
    version: "^5.0.0"
  - name: "axios"
    version: "^1.0.0"
  - name: "prettier"
    version: "^3.0.0"
2.2 核心工作流配置
2.2.1 开始节点配置
// 开始节点输入参数配置
  inputs: [
      name: "user_request",
      description: "用户需求描述或错误代码"
      name: "request_type",
      type: "enum",
      options: ["natural_language", "json_code", "error_fix"],
      default: "natural_language"
      name: "repair_mode",
      options: ["basic", "comprehensive", "thorough", "aggressive"],
      default: "comprehensive"
2.2.2 大模型节点配置
# 大模型节点配置
model_node:
  model: "DeepSeek-R1"
  temperature: 0.7
  max_tokens: 4096
  
  # 输入参数绑定
  input_bindings:
    user_input: "{{user_request}}"
    request_type: "{{request_type}}"
    repair_mode: "{{repair_mode}}"
  
  # 系统提示词
  system_prompt: |
    你是一个专业的Coze插件开发专家，请严格按照以下要求处理：
    
    1. 如果是自然语言需求：
    - 解析功能需求，识别输入输出参数
    - 生成完整的Node.js TypeScript代码
    - 包含PluginInput和PluginOutput接口
    
    2. 如果是错误代码：
    - 诊断JSON语法错误和结构问题
    - 修复节点连接问题
    - 校正参数配置错误
    - 优化代码结构
    
    3. 输出要求：
    - 直接输出可执行的代码
    - 不要包含解释性文字
    - 符合Coze平台规范

// 错误诊断器实现
class ErrorDiagnosticSystem {
  private readonly rules: DiagnosticRule[];
  
    this.rules = this.loadDiagnosticRules();
  
   * 诊断代码错误
  async diagnoseCodeErrors(code: string): Promise<DiagnosticReport> {
    const diagnostics: Diagnostic[] = [];
    
    // 1. 语法错误检查
    const syntaxErrors = await this.checkSyntaxErrors(code);
    diagnostics.push(...syntaxErrors);
    
    // 2. 结构错误检查
    const structureErrors = await this.checkStructureErrors(code);
    diagnostics.push(...structureErrors);
    
    // 3. 类型错误检查
    const typeErrors = await this.checkTypeErrors(code);
    diagnostics.push(...typeErrors);
    
    // 4. 生成诊断报告
      timestamp: new Date(),
      totalErrors: diagnostics.length,

      suggestions: this.generateSuggestions(diagnostics),

四、性能优化方案
4.1 缓存策略
// 智能缓存系统
class IntelligentCacheSystem {
  private cache: Map<string, CacheEntry>;
  private readonly maxSize: number;
  
  constructor(maxSize: number = 1000) {
    this.cache = new Map();
    this.maxSize = maxSize;
  
   * 获取缓存结果
  async getOrCompute(key: string, computeFn: () => Promise<any>): Promise<any> {
    // 检查缓存是否存在且未过期
    const cached = this.cache.get(key);
    if (cached && !this.isExpired(cached)) {
      return cached.value;
    
    // 计算新值并缓存
    const value = await computeFn();
    this.set(key, value);
  
   * LRU缓存淘汰策略
  private evictIfNeeded(): void {
    if (this.cache.size >= this.maxSize) {
      // 找到最久未使用的条目
      const lruKey = Array.from(this.cache.entries())
        .sort((a, b) => a[1].lastAccessed - b[1].lastAccessed)[0][0];
      
      this.cache.delete(lruKey);

六、部署与监控
6.1 部署配置
# deployment.yaml
apiVersion: coze.cn/v1
kind: Deployment
  name: plugin-auto-generator
spec:
  replicas: 3
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 1
      maxUnavailable: 0
      containers:
      - name: generator
        image: coze/plugin-generator:latest
        resources:
          requests:
            memory: "512Mi"
            cpu: "250m"
          limits:
            memory: "1Gi"
            cpu: "500m"
        env:
        - name: COZE_API_KEY
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: coze-secrets
              key: apiKey
        - name: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
              name: deepseek-secrets
6.2 监控配置
  port: 9090
  path: /metrics
  
alerting:
  rules:
  - alert: HighErrorRate
    expr: rate(workflow_errors_total[5m]) > 0.1
    for: 5m
    labels:
      severity: critical
    annotations:
      summary: "高错误率警报"
      description: "工作流错误率超过10%"
  
  - alert: SlowResponse
    expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(workflow_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) > 30
      severity: warning
      summary: "响应时间过长"
      description: "95%的请求响应时间超过30秒"
七、使用指南
7.1 快速开始
# 1. 安装Coze CLI
npm install -g @coze/cli

# 2. 登录认证
coze login

# 3. 部署工作流
coze workflow deploy plugin_auto_workflow.yaml

# 4. 测试工作流
coze workflow test plugin_auto_workflow \
  --input '{"user_request": "创建天气查询插件", "request_type": "natural_language"}'

// src/core/workflow-engine.ts
export class CozeWorkflowEngine {
  private workflowRegistry: Map<string, WorkflowDefinition>;
  private executionHistory: ExecutionHistory[];
  private cacheManager: CacheManager;
  
  constructor(private config: EngineConfig) {
    this.workflowRegistry = new Map();
    this.cacheManager = new CacheManager(config.cache);
  
   * 注册工作流定义
  async registerWorkflow(definition: WorkflowDefinition): Promise<void> {
    // 验证工作流定义
    const validationResult = await this.validateWorkflow(definition);
    if (!validationResult.valid) {
      throw new Error(`工作流验证失败: ${validationResult.errors.join(', ')}`);
    
    this.workflowRegistry.set(definition.id, definition);
    
    // 预编译工作流
    await this.precompileWorkflow(definition);
  
   * 执行工作流
  async executeWorkflow(workflowId: string, input: WorkflowInput): Promise<WorkflowOutput> {
    const executionId = this.generateExecutionId();
    
      const workflow = this.workflowRegistry.get(workflowId);
      if (!workflow) {
        throw new Error(`工作流不存在: ${workflowId}`);
      
      // 检查缓存
      const cacheKey = this.generateCacheKey(workflowId, input);
      const cachedResult = await this.cacheManager.get(cacheKey);
      if (cachedResult) {
        return cachedResult;
      
      // 执行工作流
      const context: ExecutionContext = {
        executionId,
        workflowId,
        input,
        startTime,
        variables: new Map()
      
      const result = await this.executeNode(workflow.startNode, context);
      
      // 缓存结果
      await this.cacheManager.set(cacheKey, result, workflow.cacheTtl);
      
      // 记录执行历史
      this.recordExecution({
        output: result,
      
      // 记录失败执行
        status: 'failed'
      
      throw error;
  
   * 执行单个节点
  private async executeNode(node: WorkflowNode, context: ExecutionContext): Promise<any> {
    switch (node.type) {
      case 'start':
        return await this.executeStartNode(node, context);
      case 'llm':
        return await this.executeLLMNode(node, context);
      case 'code':
        return await this.executeCodeNode(node, context);
      case 'condition':
        return await this.executeConditionNode(node, context);
      case 'end':
        return await this.executeEndNode(node, context);
        throw new Error(`未知节点类型: ${node.type}`);

      apiKey: this.config.doubaoApiKey,
      baseURL: 'https://doubao.cn/api/v1',
    
    // 初始化限流器

  async generatePluginCode(prompt: string, options: GenerationOptions = {}): Promise<GenerationResult> {
    const provider = this.selectProvider(options.provider);

    await limiter.acquire();
    
      const systemPrompt = this.buildSystemPrompt(options);
      const userPrompt = this.buildUserPrompt(prompt, options);
      
      const response = await provider.generateCompletion({
        model: options.model || provider.defaultModel,
          { role: 'system', content: systemPrompt },
          { role: 'user', content: userPrompt }
        temperature: options.temperature || 0.7,
        max_tokens: options.maxTokens || 4000,
        top_p: options.topP || 0.9
      
      // 验证和清理响应

        code: cleanedCode,
        provider: provider.name,
        model: response.model,
        usage: response.usage,
        warnings: this.validateCode(cleanedCode)
      
      // 失败时尝试备用提供商
      if (options.fallback && this.providers.size > 1) {
        const fallbackProvider = this.selectFallbackProvider(provider.name);
        return this.generatePluginCode(prompt, {
          ...options,
          provider: fallbackProvider.name,
          fallback: false // 防止无限回退
      
      throw new Error(`代码生成失败: ${error.message}`);

const vm = require('vm');

class CodeExecutor {
    this.context = vm.createContext({
      console: console,
      require: require,
      exports: exports,
      __dirname: __dirname,
      __filename: __filename,
      process: process,
      Buffer: Buffer,
      setTimeout: setTimeout,
      setInterval: setInterval,
      clearTimeout: clearTimeout,
      clearInterval: clearInterval,
      Promise: Promise,
      Array: Array,
      Object: Object,
      String: String,
      Number: Number,
      Boolean: Boolean,
      Date: Date,
      Math: Math,
      JSON: JSON,
      Error: Error,
      TypeError: TypeError,
      RangeError: RangeError
    this.executedModules = {};
    this.globalScope = {};

  async executePythonCode(pythonCode) {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      const simplifiedCode = this._extractPurePython(pythonCode);
      if (!simplifiedCode.trim()) {
        resolve({ success: false, message: '未找到可执行的Python代码' });

        const result = this._executePythonInNode(simplifiedCode);
        resolve({ success: true, result: result, code: simplifiedCode });
        resolve({ success: false, error: error.message, code: simplifiedCode });

  _extractPurePython(code) {
    code = code.replace(/```python\s*/g, '');
    code = code.replace(/```\s*$/g, '');
    code = code.replace(/^#.*$/gm, '');
    return code.trim();

  _executePythonInNode(code) {
    const extractedClasses = this._parsePythonClasses(code);
    const extractedFunctions = this._parsePythonFunctions(code);
    
    const nodeEquivalents = {
      classes: extractedClasses,
      functions: extractedFunctions,
      rawCode: code

    return nodeEquivalents;

  _parsePythonClasses(code) {
    const classPattern = /class\s+(\w+)\s*(?:\([^)]*\))?\s*:\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=\nclass|\ndef|\Z)/g;
    const classes = [];

    while ((match = classPattern.exec(code)) !== null) {
      const className = match[1];
      const classBody = match[2].trim();
      
      const methods = this._extractMethodsFromClass(classBody);
      classes.push({
        name: className,
        methods: methods,
        rawCode: match[0]

    return classes;

  _extractMethodsFromClass(classBody) {
    const methodPattern = /def\s+(\w+)\s*\(([^)]*)\)\s*:\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=\n\s*def|\n\s*@|\Z)/g;
    const methods = [];

    while ((match = methodPattern.exec(classBody)) !== null) {
      methods.push({
        name: match[1],
        parameters: match[2].split(',').map(p => p.trim()).filter(p => p && p !== 'self'),
        body: match[3].trim()

    return methods;

  _parsePythonFunctions(code) {
    const funcPattern = /def\s+(\w+)\s*\(([^)]*)\)\s*:\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=\n\s*def|\n\s*class|\Z)/g;
    const functions = [];

    while ((match = funcPattern.exec(code)) !== null) {
      functions.push({
        parameters: match[2].split(',').map(p => p.trim()).filter(p => p),
        body: match[3].trim(),

    return functions;

  executeJavaScriptCode(jsCode) {
      const result = vm.runInContext(jsCode, this.context);
      return { success: true, result: result };
      return { success: false, error: error.message };

  loadModule(moduleName, code) {
      const moduleContext = vm.createContext({
        ...this.context,
        module: { exports: {} },
        exports: {}

      vm.runInContext(code, moduleContext);
      this.executedModules[moduleName] = moduleContext.module.exports || moduleContext.exports;
      return { success: true, module: this.executedModules[moduleName] };

  getModule(moduleName) {
    return this.executedModules[moduleName] || null;

  setGlobal(key, value) {
    this.globalScope[key] = value;

  getGlobal(key) {
    return this.globalScope[key];

module.exports = CodeExecutor;
